name: FL3XX AI: Quote
summary: Forward a charter request email to a dedicated address and FL3XX's AI reads it and builds a pre-filled quote in the Sales module.
paragraphs: Forward a charter request email to a dedicated address and FL3XX's AI reads it and builds a pre-filled quote in the Sales module.
whyItMatters: Cuts manual re-keying of trip requests for Part 135 sales desks; the quote is still reviewed before it goes out.
